description: This script manages iOS development team IDs for signing configurations, retrieving and prioritizing team IDs from various sources such as Xcode preferences, legacy defaults, provisioning profiles, and keychain. It outputs the selected team ID based on user preferences and available data.

methods.name: detect_python
methods.description: Detects available Python 3 interpreter in the system paths.

methods.name: append_team
methods.description: Adds a team ID, its free provisioning status, and name to internal arrays if not already present.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_preferences
methods.description: Loads team IDs from Xcode preferences plist, parsing provisioning team data with embedded Python for JSON handling.

methods.name: load_teams_from_legacy_defaults_key
methods.description: Loads team IDs from legacy user defaults stored key.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_managed_profiles
methods.description: Extracts team IDs from provisioning profile files using plistlib via embedded Python.

methods.name: has_xcode_account
methods.description: Checks if an Apple account is configured in Xcode by examining the plist.
